description: Design Token System Elevation - Upgrade the foundational design tokens in tokens.css to achieve a premium, world-class color palette, refined typography scale, improved shadows, and smoother motion curves. Fix the dark theme to feel richer and more premium (less muddy purplish-gray, more deep elegant dark). Improve the light theme for crisper contrast. This is the foundation that elevates everything else.
steps: Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - DARK THEME improvements: (1) Change --bg from #0f0e13 to #09090b (deeper, cleaner black like Linear/Vercel), (2) Change --surface-1 from #1a1825 to #111113 (pure dark, less purple), (3) Change --surface-2 from #221f2e to #1c1c1e (neutral dark gray), (4) Change --surface-3 from #2d2a3d to #27272a (clean zinc gray), (5) Change --border from rgba(195,198,209,0.16) to rgba(255,255,255,0.08) (subtler, Apple-like), (6) Change --border-strong from rgba(195,198,209,0.28) to rgba(255,255,255,0.14), (7) Change --text from #eceaf5 to #fafafa (brighter, purer white), (8) Change --text-muted from #b8b5cc to #a1a1aa (clean zinc), (9) Change --text-subtle from #6b6886 to #71717a (zinc-500 equivalent)

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - DARK THEME shadows: (1) --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); (2) --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); (3) --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); (4) --shadow-xl: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); (5) --shadow-card: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); (6) --shadow-card-hover: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - MOTION tokens refinement: (1) Change --t-fast from 120ms to 150ms (slightly more perceptible), (2) Change --t-base from 200ms to 220ms, (3) Add new token --t-micro: 80ms for instant feedback, (4) Add new easing --ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) for playful micro-interactions

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - TYPOGRAPHY refinement: (1) Change --fs-base from 15px to 14.5px (tighter, more modern density), (2) Change --fs-md from 15px to 15px (keep), (3) Change --fs-lg from 17px to 18px (more contrast in hierarchy), (4) Change --fs-xl from 20px to 22px, (5) Change --fs-2xl from 24px to 28px, (6) Change --fs-3xl from 30px to 36px, (7) Add --fs-4xl: 44px for hero/landing use

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - RADIUS refinement: (1) Change --r-2xl from 20px to 16px (less bubble-like, more refined modern), (2) Change --r-3xl from 24px to 20px, (3) Keep --r-xl at 16px, --r-lg at 12px, --r-md at 8px

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - LIGHT THEME improvements: (1) Change --bg to #fafafa (slightly warmer than pure white for less harshness), (2) Improve --shadow-card-hover: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,52,97,0.08), 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(15,23,42,0.12)

Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - GLASSMORPHISM dark mode: (1) --glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.04), (2) --glass-bg-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.02), (3) --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.06). These are subtler for the cleaner dark background.
Edit frontend/src/styles/tokens.css - Add new semantic tokens at the end of :root section: --transition-all: all var(--t-base) var(--ease); --card-padding: var(--sp-5); --section-gap: var(--sp-8);
acceptance_criteria: tokens.css dark theme surface colors are cleaner neutral grays without purple tint
tokens.css has refined shadow values that work with the new darker surface
Typography scale has better differentiation between sizes (--fs-4xl added)
Border radius values are slightly tighter for a more modern feel
All existing CSS variable references remain valid (no breaking renames)
verification: Run: grep -c 'undefined\|syntax error' frontend/src/styles/tokens.css to confirm no syntax issues
Run: grep '--fs-4xl' frontend/src/styles/tokens.css to confirm new token exists
Run: grep '--t-micro' frontend/src/styles/tokens.css to confirm new token exists
Run: grep '#09090b' frontend/src/styles/tokens.css to confirm new dark bg color
findings: All 8 steps implemented successfully. Dark theme uses clean zinc-based neutral grays (#09090b, #111113, #1c1c1e, #27272a). Shadows refined for darker surfaces. Motion tokens expanded with --t-micro and --ease-bounce. Typography scale improved with better differentiation and new --fs-4xl. Radius values tightened. Light theme bg set to #fafafa. Glassmorphism values made subtler for new dark background. New semantic composition tokens added. No breaking changes to variable names.
